Audit results

Missing months: pass

Every month from January through August and September 1–4 is represented.

Source categories: pass

Each designated category was searched for every covered month; source-level last-checked dates are in the registry.

Modality balance: pass

Blood, CSF comparison, amyloid PET, and tau PET were explicitly searched; zero qualifying items are retained as zero rather than backfilled with filler.

Regulatory and recall actions: pass

FDA 510(k), drug approval, and recall databases were screened.

Coverage and coding: pass

CMS, MAC, CLFS, private-payer policy, and public PLA/CPT references were screened; policy is not conflated with payment.

Deduplication: pass

DOI, PMID, trial, FDA, recall, and organization identifiers were used; abstracts and releases were merged into definitive records.

Audit performed September 4, 2026. Source-level checked dates are in the registry.
